\begin{document}
For real $x$ the occupations add up,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{x}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-x}+1} = 1 .
\label{eq:ok}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
Scratch notes, not part of the paper:
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{x}+1} = \frac{1}{e^{-x}+1} .
\label{eq:scratch}
\end{equation}
